record.question: The implications of having single vendor is:
options: Better suited for large agencies with highly specific and strategic ICT functions
Provides greater control over vendor performance
Requires higher capacities in the department and higher coordination risk
Optimum option if all the components for external sourcing can be bundled into one group
record.explanation: A single vendor requires higher departmental capacity and coordination risk.
